observations: The fixed prompt was prepared in the system clipboard but was not submitted.
The computer-use window id became invalid after the isolated VS Code window disappeared from enumeration.
The isolated Agent Host log showed only deferred chat creation and removal; it contained no sendMessage, Skill invocation, tool call, or final response for this attempt.
macOS System Events keyboard injection returned permission violation (-10004).
A clean restart request did not produce an observable isolated VS Code window or a matching main process.
decision: Do not create run.json and do not count this attempt toward the required first three C01 runs. Restore an observable isolated VS Code window before starting C01 run-2.
